name: Houma Hunter Lime
source:
Once a month, a door behind the full moon opens. This door is between the human world and the magical world. Now it just so happens that on one such night, Lime and Bass are in hot pursuit of a demon who had stolen six power gems from the magical world. The demon escapes to the human world through the open door, and the two follow.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120108215803/http://psxdata.snesorama.us/games/J/H/SLPS-00020.html]Playstation DataCenter[/url]]
